comments.author: Ash
comments.body:
This is Correct, Got mine in Naple and Friend got some in the British South Coast.

Crickets: Naple outskirts near the Giant Tree / British isles south Coast
Ants: Morroco South Coast can be found near any structure
Worms: Genoa Outskirt near Giant tree

If you want them all i suggest Rank 6-8 Procurement (Nothing else to do with them than making pet food so better give location for them all in EU :P)
